_doc: Per-dosha exercise guidance. duration_minutes is the base; the engine adjusts for energy, activity, weather and heart-rate inputs and records why.

vata.note: Vata benefits from regularity and warmth — avoid exhausting, high-intensity workouts.

pitta.note: Pitta benefits from effort without competition or heat — exercise in the morning, never in midday sun.

kapha.note: Kapha benefits from consistent, sweat-inducing exercise — daily and invigorating.
